explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 14 days before the posting

sentences.text: The label for amlodipine besylate (NDC 68382012205) names Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3002984011) as a registered manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 1088772 of that plant ended on 2019-05-03 and was classified OAI with 14 observations noted on Form 483.
A Warning Letter was subsequently issued to the same plant on 2019-10-29.
The most recent inspection of this plant (1177670) ended on 2022-08-05 and was classified VAI.
A second registered plant (FEI 3005430968) received a Warning Letter on 2026-06-02.
Corvale East holds 155 units with 14 days on hand at current use.

rejected.text: The inspection classification became known to FDA on 2019-11-14 per the 90‑day estimate.
rejected.reason: number 90 is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-233e48.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%amlodipine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%amlodipine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-0c235d.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('fda0739d-b355-478c-acae-8f773a3ec4b3') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-0aeab8.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%amlodipine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-d3517f.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%amlodipine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-29cab1.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%amlodipine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-e3d5af.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3005430968', '3002984011') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-e0c09d.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3005430968', '3002984011') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-3e07e3.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3005430968', '3002984011') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('zydus lifesciences')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-02ba5e.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('zydus lifesciences', 'zydus') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%amlodipine%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-f0f723.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('709477', '895756', '1088772') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-b1510f.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('68382012205')

Q-cfc83c.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%amlodipine%'
